sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访几位商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zoran Mamdani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、佐兰·曼达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews at nytimes.com and in the Times app on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 nytimes.com 和《纽约时报》应用程序上直播部分采访内容。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, the secret memos of James Comey.
sentences.zh: 今天的话题是詹姆斯·科米的秘密备忘录。

sentences.en: In one of them, President Trump invites Comey to his office and asks him to drop his investigation into Michael Flynn.
sentences.zh: 其中一份备忘录显示，特朗普总统邀请科米到他的办公室，并要求他停止对迈克尔·弗林的调查。

sentences.en: He's a good guy, Trump says.
sentences.zh: 特朗普说，他是个好人。

sentences.en: I hope you can let this go.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能放过这件事。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, May 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月17日，星期三。

sentences.en: Tell us the story of what happened on February 14th.
sentences.zh: 请给我们讲讲2月14日那天发生了什么。

sentences.en: On February 14th, Jim Comey went to the White House for a regular national security briefing with other intelligence and law enforcement officials.
sentences.zh: 2月14日，吉姆·科米前往白宫，与其他情报和执法官员进行例行的国家安全简报会。

sentences.en: Michael Schmidt broke this story on Tuesday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·施密特在周二下午独家报道了这件事。

sentences.en: He was in the Oval Office with them for some time.
sentences.zh: 他在椭圆形办公室里和他们待了一段时间。

sentences.en: And then at the end of it, Attorney General Sessions and Vice President Pence, along with the president, were still around.
sentences.zh: 最后，塞申斯司法部长和彭斯副总统，连同总统，都还在场。

sentences.en: The president kicked Pence and Sessions out.
sentences.zh: 总统把彭斯和塞申斯赶了出去。

sentences.en: Sessions actually lingered again and Trump dismissed him.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯实际上又逗留了一下，被特朗普打发走了。

sentences.en: He said, please, please leave.
sentences.zh: 他说，请，请离开。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And he said, I just want to talk to Jim.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，我只想和吉姆谈谈。

sentences.en: And they had a one-on-one conversation.
sentences.zh: 于是他们进行了一对一的谈话。

sentences.en: The president sat at the Resolute desk.
sentences.zh: 总统坐在坚毅桌旁。

sentences.en: On the other side, Comey sat in a chair.
sentences.zh: 另一边，科米坐在椅子上。

sentences.en: And the president started by talking about leaks and his concerns about leaks.
sentences.zh: 总统先是谈到了泄密事件，以及他对泄密问题的担忧。

sentences.en: He brought up the fact that he thought Comey should try and put reporters in jail.
sentences.zh: 他提到他认为科米应该设法把记者关进监狱。

sentences.en: Put reporters in prison.
sentences.zh: 把记者关进监狱。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He said, look, we used to put reporters in prison 10 to 15 years ago.
sentences.zh: 他说，你看，我们10到15年前经常把记者关进监狱。

sentences.en: And that had some real impact.
sentences.zh: 那确实产生了一些真正的影响。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And then Trump turned the conversation towards Mike Flynn.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普把话题转向了迈克·弗林。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We're back now with our breaking news.
sentences.zh: 我们现在回到突发新闻。

sentences.en: And this is big breaking news.
sentences.zh: 这是一条重大的突发新闻。

sentences.en: Michael Flynn, who had resigned the previous day, has resigned.
sentences.zh: 前一天辞职的迈克尔·弗林已经辞职了。

sentences.en: A top member of the president's national security team is under investigation this morning for his contact with Russia.
sentences.zh: 总统国家安全团队的一名高级成员今天早上因与俄罗斯的接触而受到调查。

sentences.en: And who had been under an FBI investigation for his contacts with a Russian ambassador.
sentences.zh: 他此前一直因与俄罗斯大使的接触而受到联邦调查局的调查。

sentences.en: He discussed U.S.
sentences.zh: 他讨论了美国。

sentences.en: sanctions with a Russian ambassador before President Trump took office.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普总统就职前，他与俄罗斯大使讨论了制裁问题。

sentences.en: And what happened was is Trump said, look, Mike Flynn is a good guy.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的，特朗普说，你看，迈克·弗林是个好人。

sentences.en: And I just want to read the direct quote, which which is I hope you can let this go.
sentences.zh: 我想直接读一下原话，那就是：我希望你能放过这件事。

sentences.en: I hope you can see your way clear to letting this go.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能想办法放过这件事。

sentences.en: And what is the this in that sentence?
sentences.zh: 那句话里的“这件事”是指什么？

sentences.en: This is the federal investigation into Flynn and his contacts with Russian officials,
sentences.zh: 这是指针对弗林及其与俄罗斯官员接触的联邦调查，

sentences.en: including the Russian ambassador during the transition and whether Flynn had lied to the FBI about it.
sentences.zh: 包括他在过渡期间与俄罗斯大使的接触，以及弗林是否就此对联邦调查局撒了谎。

sentences.en: This is the president asking the director of the FBI.
sentences.zh: 这是总统在要求联邦调查局局长。

sentences.en: I just want to be really clear about this to do exactly what or not to do exactly what.
sentences.zh: 我想把这一点说清楚，到底是去做什么，或者不去做什么。

sentences.en: I hope you can let this go.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能放过这件事。

sentences.en: Mike and he tells him Mike Flynn had done nothing wrong.
sentences.zh: 迈克，他告诉他迈克·弗林没做错什么。

sentences.en: And Mike Flynn was a good guy.
sentences.zh: 而且迈克·弗林是个好人。

sentences.en: Mike, how do you know all this as best you're allowed and capable of saying?
sentences.zh: 迈克，在允许且有能力透露的范围内，你是怎么知道这一切的？

sentences.en: I had found out a few days ago that Comey had written extensive memos based on every conversation, every phone call, every meeting that he had with Mr. Trump,
sentences.zh: 几天前我发现，科米根据他与特朗普先生的每一次谈话、每一次通话、每一次会面，都写了详尽的备忘录，

sentences.en: because Comey was concerned about Trump.
sentences.zh: 因为科米对特朗普感到担忧。

sentences.en: He thought that Trump was going to jeopardize the independence of the investigation and the independence of the FBI.
sentences.zh: 他认为特朗普会危及调查的独立性和联邦调查局的独立性。

sentences.en: And Comey, who's known as a note taker, knew to build a written record.
sentences.zh: 而以善于做笔记著称的科米，知道要建立书面记录。

sentences.en: And that is what he did.
sentences.zh: 他就是这么做的。

sentences.en: So I learned about these memos.
sentences.zh: 所以我了解到了这些备忘录。

sentences.en: And I thought, wow, that's pretty interesting.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，哇，这太有意思了。

sentences.en: And I was moving towards trying to do a story on that.
sentences.zh: 我当时正打算就此写一篇报道。

sentences.en: Just the existence of them.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是关于它们的存在。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That would have been a pretty big story that Comey had memos that backed up his interactions with Trump.
sentences.zh: 如果科米有备忘录来支持他与特朗普的互动，那将是一个相当大的新闻。

sentences.en: That he keeps a paper trail.
sentences.zh: 他保留了书面记录。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But as I pushed on that today, I got many, many more details about this meeting and about these real issues that it created for Comey and the FBI.
sentences.zh: 但今天我深入挖掘后，得到了更多关于这次会议的细节，以及它给科米和联邦调查局带来的真正问题。

sentences.en: Is everything you've just described to me something that James Comey memorialized in a memo?
sentences.zh: 你刚才向我描述的一切，都是詹姆斯·科米在备忘录中记录下来的吗？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: James Comey walked out of that meeting in the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·科米走出了椭圆形办公室的那次会议。

sentences.en: He knew that something had gone on that he did not think was right.
sentences.zh: 他知道发生了一些他认为不妥的事情。

sentences.en: And he went back and wrote a very, very detailed two-page memo that laid out everything that happened up to, during, and after that meeting.
sentences.zh: 于是他回去写了一份非常、非常详细的两页备忘录，列出了那次会议之前、期间和之后发生的一切。

sentences.en: Did he write it the same day immediately?
sentences.zh: 他是当天立即写的吗？

sentences.en: I believe so.
sentences.zh: 我相信是这样。

sentences.en: I believe every memo that he wrote was contemporaneous to when it happened.
sentences.zh: 我相信他写的每一份备忘录都是在事情发生时同步记录的。

sentences.en: Did he write it 15 minutes after he left the White House or a day later?
sentences.zh: 他是离开白宫15分钟后写的，还是过了一天才写的？

sentences.en: I don't know, but I know that the FBI is in possession of his contemporaneous memos on these.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，但我知道联邦调查局掌握着他关于这些事情的同步备忘录。

sentences.en: They have now been left behind, even though he has been fired.
sentences.zh: 尽管他已经被解雇，但这些备忘录被留了下来。

sentences.en: They're in the hands of people in the Bureau.
sentences.zh: 它们现在在局里的人手中。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they can be subpoenaed by Congress, and Congress can haul Comey up there and ask him under oath in public what happened between him and the president.
sentences.zh: 国会可以传唤它们，国会也可以把科米传唤到那里，在公开场合宣誓询问他和总统之间到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: Mike, how much of the memo in question or memos in question have you seen or somehow become aware of?
sentences.zh: 迈克，你看到或以某种方式了解到多少关于这份备忘录或相关备忘录的内容？

sentences.en: We have not seen the memo.
sentences.zh: 我们没有看到备忘录本身。

sentences.en: We have been read parts of it and talked to folks who have seen it.
sentences.zh: 我们听人读过其中的部分内容，也和看过它的人谈过。

sentences.en: So someone with a copy of the memo in front of them literally read parts of it to you?
sentences.zh: 所以有人拿着备忘录的副本，逐字逐句地读给你听？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That is how we learned the key details that were in it.
sentences.zh: 我们就是这样了解到其中的关键细节的。

sentences.en: What did Comey say in response to President Trump in the moment, according to the memo?
sentences.zh: 根据备忘录，科米当时对特朗普总统说了什么？

sentences.en: Comey did not say, I'm going to end that investigation or I'm going to go forward with it.
sentences.zh: 科米没有说“我要结束那项调查”或者“我要继续进行调查”。

sentences.en: In response, he said yes, because the president had said Mike Flynn's a good guy.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，他说了“是”，因为总统说迈克·弗林是个好人。

sentences.en: And Comey said, yes, Mike Flynn is a good guy.
sentences.zh: 科米说，是的，迈克·弗林是个好人。

sentences.en: And that was it.
sentences.zh: 仅此而已。

sentences.en: Interesting that he also documented his own casual response to that.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，他还记录了自己当时随意的回应。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that response could be seen perhaps as inappropriate in the sense that maybe the FBI director shouldn't be weighing in whether the guy that's under investigation is a good guy or not.
sentences.zh: 那种回应或许会被认为是不恰当的，因为联邦调查局局长也许不应该去评判被调查的人是不是个好人。

sentences.en: My guess is that Comey is just sitting there trying to figure out what to say and what he can't say that would go along with what the president wanted.
sentences.zh: 我猜科米当时只是坐在那里，试图弄清楚该说什么，以及为了顺应总统的要求，他不能说什么。

sentences.en: So to be clear, do we have any reason to believe that James Comey acted on the president's request in any way?
sentences.zh: 所以明确一下，我们有理由相信詹姆斯·科米以任何方式执行了总统的要求吗？

sentences.en: No, the federal investigation of Mike Flynn went forward.
sentences.zh: 没有，针对迈克·弗林的联邦调查仍在继续。

sentences.en: In fact, Comey was concerned about the impact of this and kept it secret to him and just his close aides.
sentences.zh: 事实上，科米对这件事的影响感到担忧，并对除了他亲信助手之外的所有人保密。

sentences.en: He did not want the agents working on the investigation of Flynn to know this because he did not want them to be impacted by what the president wanted.
sentences.zh: 他不想让负责弗林调查的特工知道这件事，因为他不想让他们受到总统意愿的影响。

sentences.en: So he told very few people and definitely not anyone involved in investigating potential Trump ties to Russia.
sentences.zh: 所以他告诉的人很少，绝对没有告诉任何参与调查特朗普与俄罗斯潜在联系的人。

sentences.en: The senior FBI officials did not want the line agents to know what the president wanted.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局的高级官员不想让一线特工知道总统想要什么。

sentences.en: It's fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这太引人入胜了。

sentences.en: So, Mike, what does this request ultimately represent?
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，这个要求最终代表了什么？

sentences.en: The president of the United States asking something like that of the director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation.
sentences.zh: 美国总统向联邦调查局局长提出这样的要求。

sentences.en: This is the most significant evidence to date of the president's efforts to try and influence this incredibly politically sensitive investigation into ties between his associates and Russia.
sentences.zh: 这是迄今为止总统试图影响这项在政治上极其敏感的、关于其助手与俄罗斯之间联系的调查的最重大证据。

sentences.en: What was the White House's response as you began to put this story together?
sentences.zh: 当你开始整理这篇报道时，白宫的回应是什么？

sentences.en: I'm kind of interested in how that played out.
sentences.zh: 我有点好奇那是怎么发生的。

sentences.en: We went to them with our account of what happened and what we knew,
sentences.zh: 我们带着我们对所发生事情的描述以及我们所知道的情况去找他们，

sentences.en: and they came back to us after some time with a written statement in which they said that Trump had not asked this of Comey.
sentences.zh: 过了一段时间，他们回给我们一份书面声明，称特朗普并没有向科米提出过这种要求。

sentences.en: Last week, you broke another huge story about Trump and Comey that they had met shortly after the election and that Trump had asked Comey basically for a pledge of loyalty.
sentences.zh: 上周，你报道了另一条关于特朗普和科米的重磅新闻，说他们在选举后不久见过面，特朗普基本上要求科米效忠。

sentences.en: And the White House said that didn't happen.
sentences.zh: 白宫说那件事没发生。

sentences.en: And we asked you if you believed it, and you said, yeah, I only put things in the paper that I believe happened.
sentences.zh: 我们问你是否相信，你说，是的，我只把我相信发生过的事情写进报纸。

sentences.en: I want to take that a step further.
sentences.zh: 我想更进一步问一下。

sentences.en: What does it take to be able to put something like this, of this enormity, in the paper?
sentences.zh: 要把这种极其重大的事情写进报纸需要什么？

sentences.en: I think what made us feel comfortable about this was the specificity that we had and the folks that we talked to that had seen these memos and the detailed nature of what Comey wrote.
sentences.zh: 我认为让我们感到安心的是我们掌握的细节，以及我们交谈过的那些看过这些备忘录的人，还有科米所写内容的详细程度。

sentences.en: We've heard that Comey is almost universally admired inside the FBI, and now, thanks to you and your reporting,
sentences.zh: 我们听说科米在联邦调查局内部几乎受到普遍敬仰，现在，多亏了你和你的报道，

sentences.en: everyone inside the FBI is aware that the president asked James Comey essentially not to do his job.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局内部的每个人都知道总统实际上要求詹姆斯·科米不要履行他的职责。

sentences.en: What do you think the reaction will be to that?
sentences.zh: 你认为对此会有什么反应？

sentences.en: Regardless of what FBI agents think about the decision Comey made on the email investigation, they took a lot of pride in the fact that he was independent.
sentences.zh: 无论联邦调查局特工对科米在邮件调查中所做的决定有何看法，他们都为他保持独立而感到自豪。

sentences.en: And I think they take a lot of pride in the fact that they're trying to conduct an investigation in such a politically difficult time.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们为自己在如此政治困难的时期努力进行调查而感到自豪。

sentences.en: And the idea that Comey stared down the president wouldn't go along with his idea to kill the Flynn investigation and created a paper trail that would allow the truth to come out,
sentences.zh: 而科米顶住了总统的压力，没有顺从他终止弗林调查的想法，并留下了书面记录让真相大白，

sentences.en: I can only imagine will win over more FBI agents.
sentences.zh: 我只能想象这会赢得更多联邦调查局特工的支持。

sentences.en: Went over more FBI agents to Comey.
sentences.zh: 赢得了更多联邦调查局特工对科米的支持。

sentences.en: So are we looking at potentially a very unprecedentedly hostile relationship between the White House and the investigatory arms of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么我们是否正在目睹白宫与美国调查机构之间出现前所未有的敌对关系？

sentences.en: government?
sentences.zh: 政府？

sentences.en: You cover a lot of these agencies.
sentences.zh: 你报道了很多这些机构。

sentences.en: I think that we already are at that stage.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们已经处于那个阶段了。

sentences.en: It's basically now known that the president tried to influence this investigation.
sentences.zh: 现在基本上已经众所周知，总统试图影响这项调查。

sentences.en: And the question will be, does a special prosecutor get appointed that would essentially insulate that investigation from the White House?
sentences.zh: 问题在于，是否会任命一名特别检察官，将这项调查与白宫隔离开来？

sentences.en: I wonder if the qualities that have defined Comey throughout this investigation of the last year, the pride, the feeling that nobody should try to influence him,
sentences.zh: 我想知道，在过去一年的调查中定义了科米的那些品质，那种自豪感，那种认为没有人应该试图影响他的感觉，

sentences.en: are these all coming back to haunt President Trump now?
sentences.zh: 现在是否都在反过来困扰特朗普总统？

sentences.en: I think that if there's nothing to the Russia stuff and to the accusations about ties between his associates and Russia and any meddling in the election,
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果俄罗斯的事情以及关于他的助手与俄罗斯之间联系的指控，还有选举中的任何干预都是子虚乌有的话，

sentences.en: the president has done a very good job at creating the appearance that there's something there.
sentences.zh: 总统在制造“确有其事”的假象方面做得非常成功。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Mike.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你，迈克。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: On Tuesday night.
sentences.zh: 周二晚上。

sentences.en: Another deeply troubling allegation.
sentences.zh: 又一个令人深感不安的指控。

sentences.en: Congress needs to bring Director Comey back to testify.
sentences.zh: 国会需要带科米局长回来作证。

sentences.en: We need to get those notes if they exiSt.
sentences.zh: 如果那些笔记存在的话，我们需要拿到它们。

sentences.en: It raises serious questions of obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 这引发了关于妨碍司法公正的严重质疑。

sentences.en: I mean, that is the fundamental question here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是这里最根本的问题。

sentences.en: Is anyone, including the president of the United States, above the law?
sentences.zh: 是否有人，包括美国总统，可以凌驾于法律之上？

sentences.en: Members of Congress said they wanted James Comey to testify as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 国会议员表示，他们希望詹姆斯·科米尽快作证。

sentences.en: This isn't good for our country.
sentences.zh: 这对我们的国家不利。

sentences.en: So that's why the important thing now is to get to the bottom of everything.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么现在最重要的是查明一切真相。

sentences.en: Find the truth no matter where it may lead us.
sentences.zh: 无论真相会把我们引向何方，都要找到它。

sentences.en: Republican Congressman Jason Chaffetz, chairman of the House Oversight Committee, said he wanted to see Comey's memo about that meeting, quote, sooner rather than later.
sentences.zh: 众议院监督委员会主席、共和党众议员杰森·查菲茨表示，他希望看到科米关于那次会议的备忘录，引用他的话说，“越快越好”。

sentences.en: I have my subpoena pen ready, Chaffetz said.
sentences.zh: 查菲茨说，我已经准备好传票笔了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Dana.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫达娜。

sentences.en: I am a subscriber to The New York Times, but my husband isn't.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的订阅用户，但我丈夫不是。

sentences.en: And it would be really nice to be able to share a recipe or an article or compete with him in Wordle or Connections.
sentences.zh: 如果能和他分享食谱、文章，或者在“每日词汇”或“联想游戏”中和他一较高下，那该多好啊。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Dana, we heard you.
sentences.zh: 达娜，我们听到了你的心声。

sentences.en: It's why we created The New York Times Family Subscription.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们推出《纽约时报》家庭订阅服务的原因。

sentences.en: One subscription, up to four separate logins for anyone in your life.
sentences.zh: 一份订阅，最多可供你生活中的四个人分别登录使用。

sentences.en: Find out more at nytimes.com slash family.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/family 了解更多信息。

sentences.en: If these allegations, Senator, are true, are we getting closer and closer to the possibility of yet another impeachment process?
sentences.zh: 参议员，如果这些指控属实，我们是否正越来越接近又一次弹劾程序的可能性？

sentences.en: Reluctantly, Wolf, I have to say yes, simply because obstruction of justice is such a serious offense.
sentences.zh: 沃尔夫，我不得不勉强地说，是的，仅仅因为妨碍司法公正是一项非常严重的罪行。

sentences.en: And I say it with sadness and reluctance.
sentences.zh: 我怀着悲伤和不情愿的心情说出这句话。

sentences.en: The word has not passed my lips in this whole tumultuous three or four months.
sentences.zh: 在过去这动荡的三四个月里，我从未提起过这个词。

sentences.en: But if indeed the president tried to tell the director of the FBI who worked for him that he should drop an investigation,
sentences.zh: 但如果总统确实试图告诉他手下的联邦调查局局长，他应该放弃一项调查，

sentences.en: whether it was Michael Flynn or whether it was some investigation that had nothing to do with Russia or politics or the election,
sentences.zh: 无论那是针对迈克尔·弗林的调查，还是与俄罗斯、政治或选举无关的调查，

sentences.en: that's a very serious matter.
sentences.zh: 那都是一个非常严重的问题。

sentences.en: I want to start with a really simple question.
sentences.zh: 我想从一个非常简单的问题开始。

sentences.en: What is obstruction of justice?
sentences.zh: 什么是妨碍司法公正？

sentences.en: There are federal statutes that make it a crime to corruptly obstruct, influence, or impede any kind of official proceeding or investigation.
sentences.zh: 联邦法规规定，腐败地妨碍、影响或阻挠任何类型的官方程序或调查均属犯罪。

sentences.en: So there are laws written in very general terms that make it a crime to interfere with an investigation.
sentences.zh: 因此，法律以非常笼统的条款规定，干扰调查即构成犯罪。

sentences.en: Adam Liptak covers the law for The Times.
sentences.zh: 亚当·利普塔克负责《时报》的法律报道。

sentences.en: Adam, how hard is it to prove obstruction of justice?
sentences.zh: 亚当，证明妨碍司法公正有多难？

sentences.en: What are the basic legal requirements?
sentences.zh: 基本的法律要求是什么？

sentences.en: Well, the key thing is you do have to prove that someone had the state of mind.
sentences.zh: 嗯，关键在于你必须证明某人有那种主观心态。

sentences.en: Someone had the intent to interfere with an investigation to obstruct justice and not have it to be the incidental consequence of something they were doing for some other reason.
sentences.zh: 某人有干扰调查以妨碍司法的意图，而不是因为其他原因所做之事的附带后果。

sentences.en: And, you know, we're talking around this, but the question is proving Donald Trump's state of mind may be a challenging thing.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们一直在绕着这个问题谈，但问题在于，证明唐纳德·特朗普的主观心态可能是一件具有挑战性的事情。

sentences.en: You mentioned intent.
sentences.zh: 你提到了意图。

sentences.en: A recurring question with this president is whether he's somebody who doesn't always understand the importance and the implications of his own words.
sentences.zh: 这位总统的一个反复出现的问题是，他是否是一个并不总是理解自己言论的重要性和含义的人。

sentences.en: Could that factor into this?
sentences.zh: 这会成为其中的一个因素吗？

sentences.en: Well, there's two kinds of ways of thinking about intent.
sentences.zh: 嗯，关于意图有两种思考方式。

sentences.en: One is did you intend to break the law?
sentences.zh: 一种是你是否有意触犯法律？

sentences.en: That's not the right question.
sentences.zh: 那不是正确的问题。

sentences.en: The question is did you intend to bring about that thing?
sentences.zh: 问题是你是否有意促成那件事？

sentences.en: And in this case, the question would be did he, in speaking to Director Comey and then in firing Director Comey, mean to frustrate a federal investigation?
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，问题在于他在与科米局长交谈并随后解雇科米局长时，是否有意阻挠联邦调查？

sentences.en: Let's talk about the particulars of this situation that our colleague Mike Schmidt has just been reporting.
sentences.zh: 让我们谈谈我们的同事迈克·施密特刚刚报道的这种情况的细节。

sentences.en: And he was just on describing this memo that James Comey wrote that recalled, according to him, the president asking him to shut down the Bureau's investigation into Michael Flynn.
sentences.zh: 他刚才还在描述詹姆斯·科米写的那份备忘录，据他所说，备忘录中提到总统要求他停止联邦调查局对迈克尔·弗林的调查。

sentences.en: It felt like a pretty explicit request from the president.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是总统发出的一个非常明确的要求。

sentences.en: Could that qualify as obstruction of justice?
sentences.zh: 这能构成妨碍司法公正吗？

sentences.en: The statutes are written in general terms, and you could certainly imagine someone making the case.
sentences.zh: 法规的措辞很笼统，你当然可以想象有人会提出这种论点。

sentences.en: But as a theoretical law school hypothetical, we're in the zone.
sentences.zh: 但作为一个法学院的理论假设，我们正处于这个范畴内。

sentences.en: Adam, are memos evidence?
sentences.zh: 亚当，备忘录是证据吗？

sentences.en: It seems like they're still basically one person's account of something.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来基本上还是某个人对某事的陈述。

sentences.en: So how credible is something like that legally?
sentences.zh: 那么在法律上，这样的东西有多可信？

sentences.en: Well, they would corroborate actual testimony from Director Comey.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它们可以佐证科米局长的实际证词。

sentences.en: And having contemporaneously written down and shared with people what happened is pretty powerful evidence,
sentences.zh: 而且在事发当时就写下并与他人分享所发生的事情，这是非常有力的证据，

sentences.en: even putting aside that his testimony might well be found to be credible even without such a memo.
sentences.zh: 即使撇开这一点不谈，他的证词即便没有这样的备忘录，也很可能被认为是可信的。

sentences.en: Adam, you said this could be difficult to prove based on the question of intent.
sentences.zh: 亚当，你说过基于意图的问题，这可能很难证明。

sentences.en: Is there any evidence of intent?
sentences.zh: 有任何意图的证据吗？

sentences.en: If it was the case, as I think Mike Schmidt reported, that Donald Trump asked everyone to leave except for Director Comey, asked the vice president to leave,
sentences.zh: 如果情况正如我认为迈克·施密特所报道的那样，唐纳德·特朗普要求除科米局长以外的所有人都离开，要求副总统离开，

sentences.en: asked the attorney general to leave, and then made this request, that seems to be some evidence of a guilty conscience.
sentences.zh: 要求司法部长离开，然后提出了这个要求，这似乎就是有罪心理的一些证据。

sentences.en: And is it harder to prove the idea of obstruction of justice when you're talking about the president of the United States?
sentences.zh: 当你谈论美国总统时，证明妨碍司法公正的概念是否更难？

sentences.en: I don't know that it's harder to prove.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是否更难证明。

sentences.en: I mean, at the end of the day, you have to prove it to the satisfaction of a jury that will take into account all kinds of things, including the fact that it's the president,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，归根结底，你必须向陪审团证明这一点，而陪审团会考虑各种因素，包括这是总统的事实，

sentences.en: the fact that it's this president, all of the information that has come to light, probably a lot more that seems to be coming to light by the day.
sentences.zh: 这是这位总统的事实，以及所有已经曝光的信息，可能还有更多似乎每天都在曝光的信息。

sentences.en: So you would try to show to a jury to prove every way you can that these actions happened and were undertaken with the purpose of interfering with an investigation.
sentences.zh: 所以你会尽一切可能向陪审团证明这些行为确实发生过，并且其目的是为了干扰调查。

sentences.en: Adam, what are the paths by which a case like this might move into the legal realm in the coming weeks?
sentences.zh: 亚当，在接下来的几周里，像这样的案件可能会通过什么途径进入法律领域？

sentences.en: What would that look like?
sentences.zh: 那会是什么样子？

sentences.en: In the coming weeks, I find it hard to imagine that anything would move that quickly.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，我很难想象会有什么进展如此之快。

sentences.en: But this is a very fast-moving, volatile situation.
sentences.zh: 但这是一个变化非常快、非常不稳定的局面。

sentences.en: There are two basic paths.
sentences.zh: 有两个基本途径。

sentences.en: One is the criminal law and a prosecution, and the other is impeachment.
sentences.zh: 一个是刑法和起诉，另一个是弹劾。

sentences.en: And in the criminal law, we've talked a bit about what a prosecutor would have to prove.
sentences.zh: 在刑法方面，我们已经谈了一些检察官必须证明什么。

sentences.en: In impeachment proceedings, it's much more loosey-goosey.
sentences.zh: 在弹劾程序中，情况要随意得多。

sentences.en: It's really up to the sense of the House and Senate, what constitutes an impeachable offense.
sentences.zh: 什么构成可弹劾的罪行，实际上取决于众议院和参议院的判断。

sentences.en: But in earlier impeachment proceedings and run-ups to them, things in this general zone have been the sorts of things Congress seem prepared to pursue.
sentences.zh: 但在早期的弹劾程序及其准备阶段，国会似乎准备追究这类大致范畴内的事情。

sentences.en: You know, I guess the real answer is this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想真正的答案是这样的。

sentences.en: In a counterfactual world where the president didn't control the Justice Department and the Republicans didn't control Congress, it wouldn't surprise me at all if, say,
sentences.zh: 在一个反事实的世界里，如果总统不控制司法部，共和党也不控制国会，那么如果，比如说，

sentences.en: counterfactually, you had a Democratic-controlled House, that they might think this is an impeachable offense if proven.
sentences.zh: 反事实地说，你有一个民主党控制的众议院，如果证据确凿，他们可能会认为这是一项可弹劾的罪行，我一点也不会感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Adam, thank you very much as always.
sentences.zh: 亚当，一如既往，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激。

sentences.en: Great to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: Finally, on yesterday's show,
sentences.zh: 最后，在昨天的节目中，

sentences.en: we reported that President Trump had shared highly classified information about an ISIS terror plot with two senior officials from the Russian government last week.
sentences.zh: 我们报道称，特朗普总统上周与两名俄罗斯政府高级官员分享了关于伊斯兰国恐怖阴谋的高度机密信息。

sentences.en: The information had been given to the White House by an unnamed ally in the Middle East on the condition that it be kept confidential.
sentences.zh: 这些信息是由中东的一位匿名盟友提供给白宫的，条件是必须保密。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, my colleague Adam Goldman reported who that ally was.
sentences.zh: 周二，我的同事亚当·戈德曼报道了那位盟友是谁。

sentences.en: The ally is Israel, which is a major collector of intelligence in the region.
sentences.zh: 这位盟友是以色列，它是该地区主要的情报收集国。

sentences.en: And is obviously a close partner in the war on terror.
sentences.zh: 显然也是反恐战争中的亲密伙伴。

sentences.en: Federal officials had first asked the Times and other news organizations not to report the identity of the ally.
sentences.zh: 联邦官员曾首先要求《时报》和其他新闻机构不要报道该盟友的身份。

sentences.en: By Tuesday, the Times had decided to do so.
sentences.zh: 到周二时，《时报》已决定这样做。

sentences.en: I can't disclose our conversations today, but you can obviously imagine we would have reached out to all the appropriate authorities while running the story.
sentences.zh: 我今天不能透露我们的谈话内容，但你显然可以想象，我们在刊登这篇报道时，已经联系了所有相关部门。

sentences.en: I mean, I can say this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我可以这么说。

sentences.en: The bar for the government is very high.
sentences.zh: 政府的门槛非常高。

sentences.en: And our default position is to publish.
sentences.zh: 而我们的默认立场是发布。

sentences.en: So you have to provide a credible reason for not publishing this information.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须提供一个不发布此信息的可靠理由。

sentences.en: You know, revealing Israel's name didn't rise to that level.
sentences.zh: 你知道，披露以色列的名字并没有达到那个程度。

sentences.en: Adam, give us some context for how and why this classified information came to be gathered by Israel and then shared with the White House.
sentences.zh: 亚当，请为我们提供一些背景信息，说明这些机密信息是如何以及为什么被以色列收集，然后又与白宫分享的。

sentences.en: Here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的。

sentences.en: Israel provided us with sensitive information about an ongoing terrorism threat out of Syria.
sentences.zh: 以色列向我们提供了关于叙利亚正在发生的恐怖主义威胁的敏感信息。

sentences.en: We took that information and we provided it to the Russians, right?
sentences.zh: 我们拿到了这些信息，然后把它提供给了俄罗斯人，对吧？

sentences.en: Russia is arguably a hostile nation to us.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯可以说是一个对我们怀有敌意的国家。

sentences.en: They tried to interfere in our presidential election.
sentences.zh: 他们试图干预我们的总统选举。

sentences.en: There is a good chance Russia could have turned around and supplied that to Iran, right?
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯很有可能转手将其提供给伊朗，对吧？

sentences.en: Iran is the main enemy of Israel.
sentences.zh: 伊朗是以色列的主要敌人。

sentences.en: It's the greatest threat to Israel's existence in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 这是对以色列在中东生存的最大威胁。

sentences.en: What is the upside of Israel agreeing to share information with the Russians?
sentences.zh: 以色列同意与俄罗斯人分享信息有什么好处？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it sounds like they never had agreed to do that.
sentences.zh: 听起来他们从来没有同意这样做。

sentences.en: It just happened somewhat accidentally via President Trump.
sentences.zh: 这只是通过特朗普总统有些偶然地发生了。

sentences.en: If there's an agreement and they gave explicit permission to the Americans to do that, they have not come out.
sentences.zh: 如果有一项协议，并且他们明确允许美国人这样做，他们还没有站出来说明。

sentences.en: The administration has not come out and said that publicly.
sentences.zh: 政府还没有公开站出来说这一点。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。
